source_text.body:
Monitor Zillow listings and alert on price drops
A ChatGPT Agent Mode task checks a filtered Zillow view every six hours, compares snapshots, and sent a notification with the link when a price dropped.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
In ChatGPT Agent Mode, the author gave one detailed prompt. It named the target city, price ceiling, minimum bedrooms, must-have features, the filtered Zillow URL, and a six-hour check interval. The agent opened the page, parsed the listing cards, and stored them. On later runs it compared against what it had already seen and was told to notify only on price drops or new listings.
How it went
On the second run a price drop happened. The agent compared snapshots, flagged the change, and sent a notification with the listing link. The source gives no further results or numbers.
Worth knowing
Agent Mode needs a paid tier, since meaningful runs sit on Plus and above. The source says free accounts only get a taste, and usage limits apply.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Open this filtered Zillow search: [Zillow search URL]. Every [6] hours, record the listings and their prices, compare them to the previous check, and notify me with the listing link whenever a price drops or a new listing appears that matches my filters. Keep going until I tell you to stop, and don't contact any agents or submit any forms.
Original source: https://bluefx.net/blog/chatgpt-agent-finds-your-dream-home-automatically/
